### Format Details
* **Format Name**: (e.g. Cinema 4D, SolidWorks, OpenEXR)
* **File Extensions**: (e.g. `.c4d`, `.sldprt`, `.exr`)
* **Typical Software**: (e.g. Maxon Cinema 4D, Dassault Systèmes SOLIDWORKS, Blender)

### Requested Support
- [ ] Shell Thumbnail Provider (`IThumbnailProvider`)
- [ ] Shell Preview Handler (`IPreviewHandler`)

### Why should this format be supported?
Describe why this format would be useful to you and other users.

### Sample Files / Specifications
Please provide links to public format specifications, open-source parsers/readers, or sample files that can be used for testing.
